name: UPPER
description: UPPER converts all letters in a text string to uppercase, leaving numbers, symbols, and spaces unchanged.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text or cell reference to convert; can be a literal string in quotes or a cell.

basicExample.explanation: All lowercase letters are converted to uppercase.

advancedExamples.title: Normalize user input
advancedExamples.explanation: Mixed-case input is forced to a consistent uppercase form.

advancedExamples.title: Combine with other text
advancedExamples.scenario: Build an uppercase label from a cell
advancedExamples.explanation: UPPER is applied to the combined string so the whole result is uppercase.

howItWorks: UPPER scans each character of the input; ASCII and Unicode lowercase letters are mapped to their uppercase equivalents while every other character (digits, punctuation, spaces) passes through unchanged.

howToSteps.name: Select the text
howToSteps.text: Click the cell with the text to convert.

limitations: Case conversion follows the system's locale rules and may not cover every Unicode casing edge case.
Only affects a single text value; use with arrays or helper columns for ranges.

commonErrors.cause: Passing a non-text argument in strict contexts.
commonErrors.fix: Ensure the argument is text or wrap it with TEXT().

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: UPPER works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: Does UPPER affect numbers?
faq.answer: No, numbers, spaces, and symbols are left untouched.

faq.question: What is the opposite of UPPER?
faq.answer: LOWER converts to lowercase; PROPER capitalizes each word.

faq.question: Can UPPER handle a range?
faq.answer: In modern Excel it can spill across an array; otherwise apply it per cell or with MAP.
